synopsis: Learn how to read with Ahsoka Tano! Join Ahsoka Tano and her allies as they fight to protect the galaxy from evil. Will Ahsoka emerge victorious? Packed with fun facts, exciting color images, simple vocabulary, and a fun quiz, this Level 3 nonfiction reader will engage young fans of Star Wars and help them build confidence in reading.
title: Ahsoka Rebel Jedi
